thread:
lee: Heads-up: saw a p95 latency spike on the FlashAttention path after last canary. Model: gpt-medium, seq=16, batch=8, kv_cache=true. p95 jumped ~38ms -> ~92ms.
lee: Repro script I ran (local canary):
```
./bench.py --model=gpt-medium --kernel=auto --seq=16 --batch=8 --kv=true --runs=200
# summary: p50 18ms p95 92ms p99 150ms
```
lee: Traces show extra memcpy and more kernel launches than before; looks like the selector picked the fused variant for small seqs and that's causing syncs.
amanda: Is this only on hosted canary or also on dedicated pools? any difference between GPU types? :thinking_face:
lee: Observed on both A10g and A100 canaries. Dedicated smaller pool showed smaller effect but still >2x p95 on seq=16 workloads.
rahul: Noted — we changed the kernel selector threshold in commit 9a3f2d3 (runtime/kernel/selector): fused_flash preferred for seq < 64 when kv_enabled=true to reduce memory churn. The intention was lower mem use but maybe the fused kernel has higher launch overhead for tiny batches.
ev an: Profile (nvprof/trace) snippet: 
```
== kernels ==
flash_fused_launch x 48 (avg 0.35ms)
memcpy D2H x 48 (avg 0.58ms)
sync stream x 48 (avg 0.6ms)
--> cumulative overhead >> token compute time
```
ev an: looks like fused path introduced host syncs to service variable-length pages; combined with our micro-batches it's expensive.
perf-bot: Flamegraph uploaded: https://perf.redwood/internal/graphs/1789004321-flame (shows lots of memcpy + idle)
amanda: Quick mitigation options? revert selector change, force paged_flash for seq<32, or tune batching to coalesce tiny requests at ingress.
lee: I can open a hotfix PR to pin selector back to old behavior for seq<=32 and roll to canary. That should restore previous p95.
rahul: +1 on hotfix. Longer-term: we should fix fused kernel to avoid host syncs on page loads or move page population async. Also consider changing the selector to include observed batch sizes (not just seq/kv flag).
ev an: Also want to run these two bench variants (cache-cold vs cache-warm) to confirm KV coldstart amplification: 
```
# cold cache run
./bench.py --model=gpt-medium --kernel=flash_fused --seq=16 --batch=8 --kv=true --warm=false
# warm cache run
./bench.py --model=gpt-medium --kernel=flash_fused --seq=16 --batch=8 --kv=true --warm=true
```
lee: Good call — I'll collect warm/cold numbers and paste results in this thread.
deploy-bot: config:selector.patch deployed to canary cluster (canary-3) at 1789004378 :rocket:
rahul: After canary patch, re-run benches and also run 10k synthetic small requests to validate tail latencies.
amanda: If canary looks good, let's schedule a controlled rollout and keep the fused changes in a feature branch until we have async page load.
lee: I'll open PR for selector pin + bench logs. tagging @oncall for visibility. :thumbsup:
